note: Both sets correctly capture the VVC starlight rejection conditions, the 4 m off-axis monolith baseline, the zeroed field amplitude at the singularity, the topological charge definition, and the reduced low-order aberration sensitivity at higher charge. Set A additionally captures the IWA trade-off (higher charge gives larger IWA), an important fact on the page that Set B omits entirely. Both sets duplicate the topological charge definition and the low-order aberration sensitivity fact under two names, and Set A's two IWA claims are also near-duplicates of each other. No claims in either set are misread or invented.
remarks: Both sets restate the same facts under both a 'VVC' entity and a 'topological charge' entity (definition and low-order aberration sensitivity); Set A does the same for the IWA trade-off. Set B's omission of the IWA/charge trade-off is the main differentiator. The page text also mentions the polarizer purpose and the four coronagraph families considered, which neither set samples.
